label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.99 Beta 3: POI distances now sit on the right, replacing the favorite button. A gold star follows favorited names; swipe from right to left to add/remove Favorites. Muted +star/-star action cues and a one-time first-row swipe hint help users with no Favorites. Partial/reverse swipes do not toggle. Tapping rows or distance badges still selects a POI and opens the native map. Retains native one-cell POI fields and the Open POIs controller action from Beta 2. Existing Favorites, packs, application identity and signing key are preserved. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
